overview_description.description:
Noloco helps you replace messy spreadsheets and broken processes with tools that work exactly how you need them to. Spreadsheets are flexible, but they often become disorganized, full of errors, and hard to manage. Noloco turns them into reliable, user-friendly apps that you can customize to your team’s needs.
Noloco gives you everything you need to build your own tools:
- A spreadsheet-like database to manage your data.
- A customizable interface builder to design your app.
- Permissions and filters to control data access.
- Workflow automation to save time and reduce errors.

product.name: Noloco No-Code App Builder
product.description: A no-code platform that enables users to build custom business applications, internal tools, and client portals without coding.

product.name: Noloco Workflow Automation
product.description: Automation tools within Noloco that enable users to create workflows, automate emails, notifications, and integrate with third-party services without coding.

product.name: Noloco Data Integration and Sync
product.description: A service that connects Noloco apps to external data sources like Airtable, Google Sheets, SQL databases, and APIs for live data synchronization.

product.name: Noloco User Roles and Permissions
product.description: A feature that allows app creators to control access to data and app functionality by assigning roles and setting record- and field-level permissions.

product.name: Noloco Client Portals
product.description: A service to build secure, branded, and personalized portals that allow clients to self-serve and interact with business data and workflows.
